headline: TOREX GOLD Q2: 46% AISC MARGIN AT MEDIA LUNA — 96,297 Oz AuEq; H2 Grade Recovery On Track; Full-Year 420-470K Oz Guidance Confirmed (TSX: TXG)
snippet: Torex Gold Resources Inc. (TSX: TXG) reported Q2 2026 results August 7, producing 96,297 ounces of gold equivalent and selling 91,646 oz AuEq — in line with the company's plan as it mined through lower-grade areas of the Media Luna underground complex. Year-to-date production stands at 197,171 oz AuEq with sales of 200,868 oz. The company delivered a 46% AISC margin for the quarter, reflecting continued cost discipline at its flagship Mexico complex; gold grades and recovery rates are both expected to improve meaningfully in H2 as the mine accesses higher-grade stopes, with full-year guidance of 420,000–470,000 oz AuEq confirmed on track. A conference call with senior management was held August 7 at 9 AM ET.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING DRILLS 278.48 g/t AU OVER 1.1m AT DOME — Broad Intervals Confirmed Across Timmins Systems; Late-2026 Resource Estimates On Track (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV) reported August 5, 2026 results from 55 NQ diamond drill holes (17,845.5 metres) completed between Q4 2025 and Q2 2026 at its Dome, TVZ, and Owl Creek growth projects in Timmins, Ontario. At Dome — host to an existing 11.0-million-ounce inferred open-pit resource — drilling within and below the resource pit shell returned highlights including 278.48 g/t gold over 1.1 metres, 14.76 g/t Au over 7.8 metres, 9.09 g/t Au over 17.3 metres, and 3.86 g/t Au over 18.0 metres, supporting a planned NI 43-101 resource update in late 2026. At the Timmins Vein Zone (TVZ), underground drill results from the 1210 and 1680 levels returned 7.09 g/t Au over 17.0 metres and 6.35 g/t Au over 9.4 metres, extending the zone toward the Bermingham area. Two drills remain active across the programme with the Dome and TVZ resource estimates both targeted for completion before year-end 2026.

headline: AZTEC DRILLS 88.4m AT 1.69 g/t AuEq IN FIRST NORTH EXTENSION STEP-OUT — 6.1m Of 13.25 g/t Core; Q3 Maiden MRE Nears At Tombstone, Arizona (CVE: AZT)
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp. (CVE: AZT) reported August 5, 2026 results from nine reverse circulation holes at the Tombstone Property in southeastern Arizona — including the first step-out holes ever drilled into the recently acquired North Extension Zone. Highlight hole TR26-39 returned 88.4 metres at 1.42 g/t gold and 14.58 g/t silver (1.69 g/t AuEq) from 10.7 metres depth, including a 6.1-metre high-grade core at 12.23 g/t Au and 56.28 g/t Ag (13.25 g/t AuEq). TR26-38 in the Contention Zone returned 97.5 metres at 1.06 g/t Au and 16.08 g/t Ag from surface. Aztec has now completed 42 RC holes and 5 core holes at Tombstone in 2026 with results reported for 30 holes; assays for the most recent 11 step-out holes (TR26-40 to TR26-50) are pending and expected in coming weeks. A maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate is planned for Q3 2026 after Cassiday & Associates completed initial bottle-roll leach testing confirming oxide amenability of the gold-silver mineralisation.

headline: NEWMONT-BACKED AWALÉ CLOSES C$20.7M STRATEGIC FINANCING — $36.5M+ Cash Funds Odienné Gold JV Drilling In Côte d'Ivoire (TSX-V: ARIC)
snippet: Awalé Resources Limited (TSX-V: ARIC) announced August 6, 2026 that it has closed the second and final tranche of its strategic private placement through a subscription by Newmont Ventures Limited — a wholly-owned subsidiary of Newmont Corporation — bringing the total financing to C$20.7 million and leaving the company with over $36.5 million in cash. The funds will accelerate exploration across the Odienné Project in north-central Côte d'Ivoire, which covers 2,346 km² across seven permits including 797 km² held under the Awalé-Newmont Joint Venture where Newmont funds all exploration costs under a signed Exploration Agreement. For retail investors, the completion of a strategic financing at this scale — backed by a $20B+ gold major that already has skin in the game via the JV — validates both the geological merit of Odienné's multiple gold and gold-copper systems and Newmont's intent to stay close to a project it has the first right to advance.

headline: GREAT PACIFIC GOLD DRILLS 4TH TARGET AT WILD DOG — Magiabe Diamond Rig Launched; $22M Cash, 2 Rigs Active In Papua New Guinea (TSX-V: GPAC)
snippet: Great Pacific Gold Corp. (TSX-V: GPAC) announced August 5, 2026 the commencement of diamond drilling at the Magiabe Vein target at its flagship Wild Dog Project in East New Britain Province, Papua New Guinea — the fourth target to be drilled in 2026. One of the company's two diamond rigs was relocated to Magiabe after completing the Kasie Ridge programme; Magiabe is located approximately 700 metres southwest of the historically mined Wild Dog deposit and is interpreted to represent the southern continuation of the Wild Dog (Sinivit) epithermal gold vein system. The company holds over $22 million in cash and has two rigs advancing eight targets scheduled in the second half of 2026 for approximately 8,000 metres of drilling, including Kavasuki, Magiabe, Mengmut, Morgan and EK. PNG is an active epithermal jurisdiction and Great Pacific's well-capitalised multi-rig programme is one of the more aggressive junior exploration campaigns operating in Oceania this year.

headline: LODESTAR METALS REPORTS BULK-TONNAGE POTENTIAL AT GOLD RUN, NEVADA — First RC Results Identify Multiple Gold-Silver Styles At Robbers Knob (TSX-V: LSTR)
snippet: Lodestar Metals Corp. (TSX-V: LSTR) reported August 5, 2026 assay results from the first six reverse-circulation holes of its maiden 2,680-metre drill programme at the Gold Run Project in Humboldt County, Nevada. The initial 1,143 metres drilled at the Robbers Knob target identified multiple gold-silver mineralisation styles and broad bulk-tonnage potential across several intercepts. Lodestar is testing a series of geophysical and geochemical anomalies in a district where heap-leach oxide gold projects have historically provided the blueprint for low-cost processing. With Nevada's streamlined permitting infrastructure, rapid permitting timelines, and road access to the Robbers Knob target, any meaningful bulk-grade gold discovery here could attract attention quickly — Nevada's development cycle from first drill to construction decision is materially shorter than remote jurisdiction alternatives.

headline: WESTERN EXPLORATION SUBMITS MINE PLAN TO US FOREST SERVICE — Key Permitting Milestone At Doby George Heap-Leach Gold Project, Nevada (TSX-V: WEX)
snippet: Western Exploration Inc. (TSX-V: WEX) announced August 5, 2026 that it has submitted its Mine Plan of Operations (MPO) to the United States Forest Service for the 100%-owned Doby George gold project in the Aura district of northeastern Nevada — the required federal permitting step under USFS lead agency responsibility. The submission follows a July 7 multi-agency site visit led by the USFS where representatives reviewed the proposed project layout and discussed the scope of work; their feedback was incorporated into the MPO as filed. A 2025 Preliminary Economic Assessment confirmed Doby George as a near-surface oxide heap-leach opportunity, and a drill rig is scheduled to arrive for up to 3,000 metres of infill holes to convert inferred resources to the indicated category ahead of a pre-feasibility study. At $4,270+ gold, heap-leach oxide projects with low capital thresholds and simple metallurgy are among the most compelling development-stage assets on the junior market — Western's MPO submission represents a meaningful de-risking of the permitting pathway.

headline: EXCELLON HITS FIRST SILVER CONCENTRATE AT MALLAY — 29,200 Oz Ag From Pre-Commissioning; Peru Mine Targets First Shipments August 2026 (EXNRF)
snippet: Excellon Resources Inc. (OTC: EXNRF) announced August 5, 2026 that its 100%-owned Mallay Silver-Lead-Zinc Mine in central Peru has achieved first concentrate production during its pre-commissioning campaign, which commenced July 2. The 600 tpd flotation plant has processed approximately 12,000 tonnes of ore, producing concentrates containing roughly 29,200 ounces of silver, 319,000 pounds of lead, and 456,000 pounds of zinc; the plant is currently operating at ~400 tpd to support metallurgical optimisation before a ramp to nameplate capacity. Initial concentrate shipments are targeted for August 2026. Simultaneously, dewatering of the 400 Ramp has lowered water levels approximately 45 metres, with rehabilitation expected to take roughly three months and enable access below the 4090 Level — opening deeper, higher-grade ground to future development. For silver investors, Mallay's first concentrate milestone at $62/oz silver represents meaningful operating leverage turning on at precisely the right moment in the silver price cycle.

headline: LI-FT POWER LAUNCHES C$20M BOUGHT DEAL — Canaccord-Led Financing Covers Renard Option + Yellowknife Lithium Assets (TSX-V: LIFT)
snippet: Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSX-V: LIFT, ASX: LFT) announced August 4, 2026 that Canaccord Genuity Corp. has agreed to lead a bought-deal public offering of 6,900,000 common shares at C$2.90 per share for gross proceeds of C$20,010,000 — with a 15% over-allotment option exercisable within 30 days. Closing is targeted on or about August 12, subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval. Net proceeds will fund the first year of care and maintenance costs under the Renard Option Agreement — giving Li-FT access to the historic Renard kimberlite complex for potential lithium-bearing pegmatite exploration — and provide working capital for the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project in Quebec's James Bay region and the Yellowknife Lithium Project in the Northwest Territories. Li-FT is one of a small cohort of hard rock lithium explorers in Canada with active programmes in two producing-friendly jurisdictions, and this financing provides a funded runway into what would be the second half of a multi-year exploration programme targeting large, low-cost lithium pegmatite systems adjacent to infrastructure.

headline: VANECK GOLD SWOT: CHINA IMPORTS 790+ TONNES SILVER IN EARLY 2026 — Solar Acceleration Driving Structural Demand; 'Supply Deficit Year 7' Is The Thesis
snippet: VanEck's weekly Gold SWOT report for the week of August 4, 2026 highlights silver demand as the defining structural driver underpinning the current $60+ price level: China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026, driven primarily by the accelerating domestic solar panel manufacturing build-out responding to higher energy costs. VanEck analysts note this is the seventh consecutive year in which annual global silver consumption is projected to exceed mine production — a structural deficit now so extended that the silver market's supply-demand arithmetic can no longer be explained by a single demand cycle. For junior mining investors, the report frames the current silver market as one where any addition to physical supply through new mine development or resource expansion at existing producers is being absorbed without disrupting the deficit structure — making high-grade silver exploration results directly relevant to a supply story that industrial buyers are already pricing in.
